_readme: First-day tutorial tips. Each tip shows once per run, when its trigger happens, if Settings > Tutorial is on. Triggers are fired by the shop scene.

pages: Welcome to your shop! Customers wait at the FRONT COUNTER on the far left. Walk with the D-pad and press A to talk to them.
B jumps. START opens the menu: your job, shop stats, training, the Shop Ledger and End Day.
A blinking ! marks every station with work for this job. Walk there and press A. The bottom bar shows your progress.
Each task is a quick minigame: press A while the marker is in the dark zone, press each button as it lights up, or hold A and let go on the target.
Better work means better pay and a better reputation.
The bike is done! Take it back to the FRONT COUNTER to hand it over and get paid.
Quality and speed set what customers pay and how your reputation moves.
Restock at the PARTS WALL. The door up the ladder is the TRAINING CENTER. When you're done for the day: START > END DAY.
Each night you pay overhead and your own wage, then make a decision. Twelve months to build your shop. Good luck!
